payload.title: Direct information minimization under finite common-cause factorization
payload.method: Directly minimize I(Lambda;X) under common-cause factorization and exact quantum-table reconstruction; K=2,4,8,16 with warm starts and latent splitting; SLSQP.
payload.acceptance: Feasibility tolerance 2e-6; reported table/equality residual acceptance threshold 5e-5. Optimizer status and feasibility must be treated separately.
payload.comparison: At theta=16.875, best fitted value remains above unrestricted convex minimum 0.02262065 bits. At theta=45, K16 is approximately 1.13e-8 bits above unrestricted minimum 0.04627384698. K8's slightly lower value is not accepted as a genuine improvement because its residuals are larger.
payload.interpretation: Evidence of feasible finite common-cause representation, but no global minimum proof for the nonconvex factorized problem and no physical mechanism.
